{{Quote|Our general wishes to speak with you about the canceled attack.|The tactical droid, to Jar Jar Binks|<ref name="Shadow Warrior">{{TCW|Shadow Warrior}}</ref>}}
A '[[T-series tactical droid/Legends|''T-series tactical droid''']] with [[Gender/Legends|feminine]] programming was in the service of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]].

==Biography==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Rish Loo/Legends|Rish Loo]] took control of [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Lyonie/Legends|Lyonie's]] mind and had him declare war on the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo people]]. However, the arrival of [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] turned the tide and Rish Loo was chased away but not before gravely wounding Lyonie during a skirmish.

[[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] was seen to resemble Lyonie a lot and since Lyonie never got a chance to call off the attack, Jar Jar was to pose as Boss Lyonie and call off the attack. The plan worked but then [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], who still thought the Gungans were his allies because of Rish Loo, sent the tactical droid and a few battle droids to inquire about the canceled attack. The tactical droid then led Jar Jar and a Gungan warrior, [[Roos Tarpals/Legends|Roos Tarpals]] to Grievous. Apparently, Grievous saw through the trick and tried to kill Binks but got himself captured after he and Tarpals had a brief duel, ending in Tarpals being stabbed with a spear, but with him likewise piercing Grievous's armor with his own spear, allowing him to be subdued with a barrage of [[Booma/Legends|Boomas]]. At the same time, Skywalker was captured by [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and a few [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|Magnaguards]] while chasing Rish Loo. The tactical droid was present when an exchange of both hostages took place. She threw Skywalker's lightsaber back at him and left the planet with Grievous.
